messages:
maggie: FYI Escrowly just opened a P0 — p99 tail latency on their Dedicated pool (pool-12) spiked to ~3s starting ~04:00 UTC. Customer is worried about timeouts.

sam: looking at traces now, KV cache hit rate dropped. Might be a KV eviction storm after last night's rollout.

paulina: can we confirm whether autoscaler kicked? I see no scale events in the past hour.

raj: autoscaler healthy but pool-12 hit max_burst config. We hit capacity cap for the device class. Increasing burst helps but it's a config change (needs approval).

lina: Escrowly reports their API errors increased — they want a short-term workaround before we touch config. Asking about traffic shaping.

sam: short-term plan: route Escrowly to pool-14 (same HW class) + enable prefix KV cache for their keyspace to reduce recompute. I have a branch that gates routing by customer-id: https://git.redwood/infra/route/compare/PR-3421

maggie: timeline request from CS: ETA for routing change + cache enable? They want rolled within next 2 hours or they'll hit SLA credits.

sam: I can get the PR to green in ~35m but need an oncall to approve gradual rollout pattern. @paulina can you review the canary policy?

paulina: on it — will check the rollout config and the metrics dashboard. If route change is live, we should also enable automatic fallback to model-compact when latency > 800ms for 1m.

raj: I can lift max_burst for pool-12 as hotpatch if we need, but prefer routing to pool-14 first. Hotpatch command (internal):
```bash
# increase burst, expires in 2h
redctl pools update pool-12 --max-burst 120 --expires=2h
```
Do we want me to run that?

lina: Escrowly agreed to routing if we can confirm no extra auth work. They just need a signed confirmation. I can send a note once change is set to canary.

maggie: Priority: 1) safe route to pool-14 canary 2) enable prefix KV cache 3) fallback policy 4) if still bad, apply burst hotpatch. Owners: sam (routing + cache), paulina (rollout + fallback policy), raj (burst hotpatch), lina (customer comms).

sam: PR-3421 now has unit tests failing on throttler — pushing fix, should be green in 10m. Will add rollout snippet: `--canary-percentage=5 --verify-latency=1m`

deploy-bot: deploy queued: PR-3421 -> canary (pool routing) requested by sam. CI status: running.

paulina: quick note — set monitoring alert for redis eviction rate before and after cache toggle. If eviction rate spikes, rollback immediately.

raj: if deploy fails or CI flakes, I'll run the hotpatch to avoid customer downtime. Running hotpatch needs an entry in change-log (I can handle).

maggie: good. Lina, once canary is up please send Escrowly: "Canary routing live at 5% now; monitoring p99; update in 20m."

lina: will send. Also ping legal for the temporary config change note.

sam: CI passed, merging PR-3421. kicking off canary.

deploy-bot: deploy started: PR-3421 -> canary (5%) [pool-14 routing], started by sam at 04:28 UTC.

paulina: canary metrics look stable at 10m mark — p95/p99 not regressing for other customers.

maggie: Escrowly response: "Seeing improvement, errors down 70%". Customer still watching but appreciative.

raj: leaving burst hotpatch on standby. If latency > 1.2s for Escrowly for 3 consecutive 1m windows, I will execute and post changelog.

sam: moving to 50% canary now per rollout policy.

deploy-bot: canary update: 50% -> in progress.

lina: CS note drafted, sending now.

maggie: Thanks team. Action items: sam — confirm full rollout timeline and add KB entry for routing failover; paulina — add fallback rule and eviction alerts; raj — stand by for hotpatch; lina — keep customer updates. I'll update execs after final verification. :thumbsup:

sam: will follow up with a short PR to ops-docs.

paulina: creating the alert runbook now.

raj: ping me if you need an immediate burst change.

lina: Escrowly confirming reduced errors and will monitor for 24h. Closing P0 if stable.

maggie: closing notes: PR-3421 merged, rollout at 50%, monitoring green at last check. Leaving thread open for 24h for follow-ups"
